Technology description including backgro: Metal waterstop is an internal water bar, one-sided coated over the entire surface for fast, simple and reliable sealing of construction and crack inducing joints. The internal water bar has an adherent, reactive polymer coating on one of its side. This coating has to be positioned towards the waterside. The high bonding characteristics of the polymer coating prevent the internal Metal waterstop from being infiltrated. The product is manufactured at Junghansring 52 in Rottenburg a. N. The slit strip is delivered to the production site and inserted into the sheet metal machine. The adhesive tape is clamped and glued to the inserted sheet metal. The metal waterstop is then packaged for transportation. | |
